scope: Independent aggregate-methods and claim-boundary review of the final CM–aGPi audit; privacy, study denominators, phase/coherence distinctions, trial-family overlap and public-only next gate.
verdict: No material correction required in the reviewed scope.
verified_boundaries: Six implanted, five physiology contributors, eight broader-trial enrollees remain separate.
Adult-only applicability and selective surgical cohort are explicit.
The three-month/nine-visit discrepancy remains unresolved rather than silently repaired.
Phase lead is not promoted to causal generation or therapeutic benefit.
Low-gamma phase positives and contradictory broad negative wording are retained.
Statistical-unit ambiguity is not labelled proof of invalid statistics.
Linked-trial provenance is not treated as independent replication or exact identity matching.
The next task uses lawful public aggregate material and stops before unsupported efficacy calculations.

independent_math_check.method: Rank-sum generating-function coefficients, independently compared with main sign enumeration.

limitations: This review does not reproduce the original physiological calculations or inspect restricted participant data.
The unavailable supplement may contain clarifications.
Older thalamocortical reports were not comprehensively re-audited in this review.
This is source/methods review, not clinical peer review.
